content.subject: Reconciliation workload at ShipMonk
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because the growing reconciliation workload may be an area we could help with.

I read your post about joining ShipMonk as CFO, especially your point about driving growth and scaling in logistics and ecommerce. I imagine keeping intercompany reconciliation aligned across expanding fulfillment systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We pull data from your fulfillment platforms and reconcile it against accounting records, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
